title: Can a Dynamic Internal Field Govern a Transformer's Cognition? Certifiability, not Superiority, in Homeostatic Compute Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.24319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An intelligent system does not merely reason: it governs its own reasoning - how much to compute, when to stop, which module to activate. Can that role be played by a dynamic internal field - a low-dimensional homeostatic state with explicit physics and certified stability - that modulates cognition without performing it? Ours is a field on the module graph governed by a family of PDEs on the graph Laplacian, advancing with an adaptive-depth reasoner. We certify the stability of the integrator of the whole family - an integrator certificate, not a closed-loop one. New, and proved here: a discrete Schur-Cohn criterion for Verlet with velocity coupling, necessary and sufficient per latent root, with no commutation hypothesis. The answer is threefold: substance no, structure only in part, certifiability yes. The type of the field's physics is irrelevant for accuracy: wave, diffusion, gated mixtures and a 2D Navier-Stokes substrate tie. A tw

translated_title: 动态内部场能否支配Transformer的认知？在稳态计算控制中的可认证性而非优越性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24319v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个智能系统不仅仅是推理：它管理自身的推理过程——计算多少、何时停止、激活哪个模块。这种角色能否由一个动态内部场——一个具有明确物理特性和认证稳定性的低维稳态状态——来扮演，该场调节认知而不执行认知？我们的场位于模块图上，由图拉普拉斯算子上的偏微分方程族驱动，与自适应深度推理器协同推进。我们认证了整个方程族积分器的稳定性——这是一个积分器认证，而非闭环认证。本文新证明了一个离散的Schur-Cohn准则，用于带速度耦合的Verlet方法，对每个潜在根给出必要且充分的条件，无需交换性假设。答案是三重的：实质内容上没有，结构上仅部分，可认证性上确实有。场的物理类型对准确性无关紧要：波动、扩散、门控混合以及二维Navier-Stokes基底均表现相当。
tldr: 本文证明动态内部场在Transformer认知控制中主要提供可认证的稳定性而非性能优势，其物理类型不影响准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a dynamic internal field offers certifiable stability rather than performance superiority in Transformer cognitive control, with its physical type irrelevant to accuracy.
